capabilities: Preview the rendered Reading View of a note as an HTML page at desktop, tablet, and phone widths
Adjust page layout and the size and alignment of images, Mermaid diagrams, and tables
Export as a single-file HTML or an HTML-plus-assets folder
Preserve theme styles, CSS snippets, images, and Mermaid diagrams in the output
Choose an export destination inside or outside the vault with replace confirmation
disambiguation: Not only a previewer; previewing and layout adjustments are steps toward producing a shareable HTML file.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.15.0 or later. The in-app interface is currently mainly in Chinese. Exports are based on Reading View, so some theme effects, interactive content, and cross-note links may not carry over; remote fonts or styles may need internet access during export. Version history suggests an early release (0.1.x).
problem: Sharing a styled note with people who don't use Obsidian means losing theme styles and diagrams or hand-writing HTML and CSS.
summary: Exports rendered Obsidian notes as shareable HTML pages, with an in-app preview for checking and adjusting layout before export.
